quote: A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle, except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic or in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or official traffic-control device, in any of the following places: Within 50 feet of the nearest rail of a railroad.

activation.condition: A driver stops, stands or parks within 50 feet of the nearest physical rail of a railroad.

obligation.description: Do not stop, stand or park within the statutory rail distance unless a source exception applies.
obligation.source_clause: shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle

exceptions.trigger: Necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic
exceptions.effect: The prohibition has an exception only when actual necessity is established from original traffic evidence.
exceptions.replacement_obligation: Retain original vehicle conflict observations for independent review.
exceptions.source_clause: except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic

exceptions.effect: The prohibition has an exception when another applicable law actually requires or permits the activity.
exceptions.replacement_obligation: Retain and independently review the cited law and original conduct.

exceptions.effect: The prohibition has an exception when an actual police direction applies.
exceptions.replacement_obligation: Retain original officer direction and response for review.
exceptions.source_clause: the directions of a police officer

exceptions.effect: The prohibition has an exception when an official device direction applies.
exceptions.replacement_obligation: Retain original device identity, indication and response for review.

timing.description: Observe the complete requested stop, stand or park interval; the law gives no activity duration threshold.
